items.author: David Nguyen, Data Analytics Leader, 3x Tableau DataDev Ambassador, Nov 22
items.summary: Simulated a 200-drone show (355,800 data points) and analyzed its safety in a Tableau Data App with a 3D orbit/replay and a Meta Quest 3 mixed-reality preview; found 2 drones within 1.53 m and 4 'underground' data errors. App link promised in a follow-up post. Video; counts not shown yet (posted ~30m before scan).

items.author: Matt Meier, Tableau Ambassador, Dir. Investment Data Operations & Visualization at Omnicom, Nov 22
items.summary: His first Tableau Data App, "The Urban Care Paradox", built in about 10 minutes of prompting with Tableau Agent and Gemini plus manual CSS/HTML tweaks; argues AI is a tool for analysts, not a replacement. 5 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Adam Mico, Product Management Director, Tableau, Nov 22
items.summary: Issue 1 of his "Shipped, Explained" newsletter: a DataFam guide to Tableau Skills in Studio (11 packaged, 46 opt-in on Tableau Exchange, his 8 picks). 47 reactions, 7 comments, 6 reposts.

items.author: Yanis Mathiopoulos, Data Lead, AI, Revolut, Nov 20
items.summary: If everyone can write SQL and build reports with AI, what should analysts do? Six Revolut practices: answer tables, semantic-layer docs, reusable skills, Slack agents, selective automation, and the right output tool (Looker, HTML, Confluence). 53 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: Chris McClellan, Tableau, Alteryx, Snowflake, dbt, Python practitioner, Nov 22
items.summary: Built FocusKit, a free open-source 50 KB Windows tray tool (spotlight, zoom, draw) for walking people through dashboards on Teams/Zoom, made with Claude Code. 6 reactions, 1 comment.

items.summary: Power BI November 2026 roundup: cards get a trend axis, style presets, an on-visual filter button, date slicers; heads-up that standalone Power BI Copilot ends January 2027 (Copilot inside reports stays). 139 reactions, 2 comments, 12 reposts.
